cases.sentence: я увидел в правой руке сидящего на троне ___
cases.translation: I saw in the right hand a scroll
cases.explain: As the direct object of 'увидел' (saw), the noun takes accusative case; for inanimate masculine nouns, accusative equals nominative
The instrumental form of семь (seven) requires the instrumental case for the noun
As the direct object of 'увидел' (saw), animate nouns take accusative case; for animate masculine nouns, accusative equals genitive

cases.translation: which are the seven spirits of God
cases.explain: After the numeral 'семь' (seven, 5+), nouns take the genitive plural case

cases.translation: the Lion of the tribe of Judah has overcome
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) requires the genitive case

cases.sentence: я увидел в самом центре трона ___
cases.translation: I saw a Lamb in the center of the throne
cases.explain: As the direct object of 'увидел' (saw), animate nouns take accusative case; for animate masculine nouns, accusative equals genitive

cases.translation: as though it had been brought as a sacrifice
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (into) requires the accusative case
After the numeral 'семь' (seven, 5+), nouns take the genitive plural case

reading.ru: Потом я увидел в правой руке сидящего на троне свиток, исписанный с обеих сторон и запечатанный семью печатями.
reading.question: What did the narrator see in the right hand of the One seated on the throne?
options: A book written on one side only
A scroll written on both sides and sealed with seven seals
A golden cup filled with wine
reading.correct: A scroll written on both sides and sealed with seven seals
reading.explain: The text states: 'свиток, исписанный с обеих сторон и запечатанный семью печатями' (a scroll written on both sides and sealed with seven seals)

reading.ru: Но никто ни на небе, ни на земле, ни под землей не мог раскрыть свиток и посмотреть, что внутри.
reading.question: Who was able to open the scroll?
options: No one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth
reading.correct: No one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth
reading.explain: The text explicitly states: 'никто ни на небе, ни на земле, ни под землей не мог раскрыть свиток' (no one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open the scroll)

reading.ru: Тогда один из старцев сказал мне, 'Не плачь. Смотри, победил лев из рода Иуды, корень Давида.'
reading.question: Who is described as conquering and is compared to a lion?
options: The lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David
reading.correct: The lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David
reading.explain: The text says: 'победил лев из рода Иуды, корень Давида' (the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome)

reading.ru: И я увидел в самом центре трона, в окружении четырех живых существ и старцев, ягненка, выглядевшего так, будто его принесли в жертву.
reading.question: Where is the Lamb positioned, and what does it look like?
options: Standing on top of the throne looking majestic
In the center of the throne surrounded by four creatures and elders, appearing as though slain
At the bottom of the throne radiating light
Flying above the throne with outstretched wings
reading.correct: In the center of the throne surrounded by four creatures and elders, appearing as though slain
reading.explain: The text states: 'в самом центре трона, в окружении четырех живых существ и старцев, ягненка, выглядевшего так, будто его принесли в жертву' (a Lamb in the center surrounded by four creatures and elders, appearing as though slain)

reading.ru: У каждого из них в руках было по арфе и по золотому сосуду, полному благовоний.
reading.question: What did each of the beings hold in their hands?
options: A harp and a golden bowl full of incense
reading.correct: A harp and a golden bowl full of incense
reading.explain: The text says: 'в руках было по арфе и по золотому сосуду, полному благовоний' (in their hands a harp and a golden bowl full of incense)

reading.ru: 'Ты достоин взять свиток и снять с него печати, ведь ты был принесен в жертву и своей кровью выкупил людей для Бога, людей из всех родов, языков, народов и племен'.
reading.question: What makes the Lamb worthy according to this passage?
options: That He was sacrificed and with His blood redeemed people from every tribe, language, nation, and people
His wisdom and understanding of all mysteries
reading.correct: That He was sacrificed and with His blood redeemed people from every tribe, language, nation, and people
reading.explain: The text says: 'ты был принесен в жертву и своей кровью выкупил людей для Бога, людей из всех родов, языков, народов и племен' (you were sacrificed and with your blood redeemed people for God from every tribe, language, nation, and people)
